Name: Aspect of Tithiss
Information:
**Aspect of Tithiss**

When in combat, Tithiss uses the overwhelming strength that comes from being an embodiment of earth itself to strike out at others, and utilizes corrosive sap and poison. They freely unleash their control over nature to grant life to trees and flora. Usually, Tithiss will be docile and gentle, but they are known to have a distaste for appearing in the Material Plane: when they must, the progression of technology upsets their nature, and they may fly into a rage against their surroundings.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Tithiss’s spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. Tithiss’s spells are cast at 5th level, unless their base level is higher.

spellcasting.casting_level_note: 5th level, unless their base level is higher

traits.name: Living Avatar of the Earth (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description: When Tithiss would be reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, its hit points are instead reset to 150, it regains spent Legendary Reactions and cast spells, for 1 hour it can use its Mythic Actions, and it may choose to immediately use Weary Garden Bed. During this time, they can treat any naturally occurring ground around them (dirt, stone, etc.) as though it was them, and can make attacks from any of those spaces as though she was occupying them. All earth, dirt, grass, and other naturally occurring terrain within 120 feet of it becomes difficult terrain for all creatures except itself. If a party defeats Tithiss after it uses its Living Avatar of the Earth, they are awarded an additional 25,000 XP (for a total of 50,000).

traits.name: Zenith of Earth
traits.description: Any earth elemental that has a CR lower than 15 who attempts to act against or defy Tithiss, or disobey its orders, must make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they must either act according to its will, or be stunned until they do (even if they normally wouldn’t be stunned). Creatures stunned this way repeat the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature who succeeds either save becomes immune to it for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tithiss makes one attack each with their Floral Vine Strike and Arm of Arrestment. It can replace one of those attacks with casting a spell with a casting time of 1 action using their Innate Spellcasting.

actions.name: Floral Vine Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 5) piercing damage. If this attack hits a target and exceeds their armor class by 10 or more, Tithiss may entangle them and move them into any unoccupied space within the attack’s reach from her, where they are dropped prone. She may only do so to target no more than three size categories larger than her.

actions.name: Arm of Arrestment
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) acid damage. If this attack hits a target and exceeds their armor class by 10 or more, they must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failure they are poisoned for 1 hour, and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns. A creature who succeeds the saving throw ends the effect and is immune to being poisoned this way for 24 hours.

actions.name: Mythic Action: Thorn Garden
actions.description: Tithiss makes four Floral Vine Strike attacks.

actions.name: Mythic Action: Destructive Hand of Nature (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Tithiss causes the earth to erupt and strike out at all creatures within 300 feet of her. Creatures within this range must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. Creatures who are more than 30 feet above the ground have advantage on this saving throw. Creatures who fail are grasped and crushed by huge tree-like hands from the earth, and take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage plus 33 (6d10) acid damage, or half as much on a success. Creatures who fail this saving throw by 5 points or more are also restrained and grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Mythic Action: Weary Garden Bed (1/Rest)
actions.description: Tithiss returns to Large size, and surrounds herself in a Tremendous tree, in which she rests inside a cocoon of bark, leaves, and sap. She is incapacitated while within, but each turn the tree (which shares her AC, saving throws, ability scores, resistances, immunities, and her senses - though it is vulnerable to fire damage) can use her Thorn Garden, targeting no creature more than twice, and ignoring Flora Vine Strike’s secondary effect. The tree is treated as a plant creature, and has 150 hit points. Tithiss cannot be targeted or damaged while within. At the start of each of Tithiss’s turns while within, she gains 4d10 + 20 temporary hit points, which add on to previous temporary hit points gained this way. She can accumulate up to 200 temporary hit points this way. If she begins her turn and the tree has 0 hit points, she emerges in any space it was occupying and it vanishes, leaving only a husk behind.

bonus_actions.name: Banishment
bonus_actions.description: Tithiss banishes any number of elementals it can see who are stunned by its Zenith of Earth trait back to the Elemental Plane of Earth, or can immediately deal 55 (10d10) force damage to them.

bonus_actions.name: Change Size
bonus_actions.description: Tithiss changes their size to become any size between Medium and Tremendous. For every two size categories larger than Large it becomes, its Arm of Arrestment reach increases by 5 feet, and its Floral Vine Strike reach increases by 10 feet.

options.name: Binding Hand
options.description: Tithiss makes a grapple attempt against one creature within 60 feet of itself. If they fail, they are grappled (escape DC 19) and pulled into an unoccupied space within reach of her Arm of Arrestment, and Tithiss grows a new arm to replace it while that one grapples them.

options.name: Blooming Poison
options.description: Tithiss causes flowers to bloom at a point she can see within 60 feet, where they release poison spores in a 15-foot radius sphere. Each non-elemental creature in that space must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (2d12 + 8) poison damage on a failure. Creatures who fail by 5 points or more are poisoned until the end of Tithiss’s next turn.

options.name: Living Forest (Costs 3 Actions)
options.description: Tithiss transforms a Huge or larger tree within 120 feet into a treant under her control. This treant counts as an elemental and shares her Earthglide trait. All treants created this way return to being trees if she is reduced to 0 hit points, even if she uses her Mythic Awakening. She can only have up to four treants animated this way at a time.

options.name: Arm Strike
options.description: Tithiss makes an Arm of Arrestment attack.

options.name: Replenish Garden (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Each elemental and plant creature Tithiss chooses within 60 feet of her gains 33 (6d10) temporary hit points.

options.name: Prison of Sap (Costs 3 Actions)
options.description: Three creatures Tithiss chooses within 60 feet must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are encased in a sphere of sap, where they are restrained. Creatures restrained this way have total cover against anything outside, and vice versa. These sap shells have 18 AC, 30 hit points, and resistance to nonmagical weapon damage. If they are broken they crumble into dust. If Tithiss uses this feature again, existing sap shells vanish. Tithiss may still target creatures trapped like this with spells, as though they didn’t have cover.

mythic_actions.intro: For 1 hour after using Living Avatar of the Earth (Mythic Awakening)
